title: Two controllers in couch co-op
intro: Needs TWO controllers connected and a second person (or two hands). Start as the Arisen, no co-op running. Press End (keyboard) to start.

steps.text: Turning on two controllers and starting co-op with your main pawn.
PLAYER 2: hold L1 + L3 on your controller until it says it is set, then let go. Press End when done.
Each player moves on their own stick: Arisen on controller 1, pawn on controller 2. Does each stick move only its own character?
Buttons: both attack, jump and sprint. Does each controller only work its own character? (Mode 1: take out player 2's buttons)
Cameras: player 1 turns the camera with the right stick while player 2 also moves their right stick. Camera follows player 1 only?
Mode 2 (leave the Arisen's buttons to the game, joseau11's way): same button check. Different?
Mode 3 (player 1's controller only). joseau11 saw the main menu keep opening with this: if it does, press Esc / Circle and wait for the next step.
Camera mode 2 (holds still while player 2 moves their right stick). Compare with before.
Ending co-op and turning two controllers off. Tell Claude which button mode and camera mode worked, and anything odd.

probes.pads:
local R = _G.DPC_dbg and _G.DPC_dbg.R
if not R or not R.tp then return "no DPC dev" end
local t = R.tp
return string.format("pads=%d p1=%X p2=%X wait=%s on=%s p1b=%X p2b=%X game_b=%X masked=%d stick=%d cam=%d%s", t.n or 0, t.p1 or 0, t.p2 or 0,
  tostring(t.wait_release), tostring(R.tp_on()), (t.p1v and t.p1v.b) or 0, (t.p2v and t.p2v.b) or 0, t.game_b or 0,
  t.masked or 0, t.stick_fixes or 0, t.cam_fixes or 0, t.err and (" ERR " .. t.err) or "")
